deficits.evidence: A continuous wall and overgrown vegetation line the road edge, leaving no space for a pedestrian to walk safely off the carriageway.
deficits.suggestion: Construct a paved footway along the left side by reclaiming space from the verge.

deficits.evidence: A high, weathered wall and dense vegetation run along the right edge, providing no safe path for pedestrians.
deficits.suggestion: Construct a paved footway along the right side by reclaiming space from the verge.

deficits.evidence: The road is lined with buildings on both sides, creating a need to cross, but there is no marked or physical crossing facility visible.
deficits.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing with a central refuge island to provide a safe crossing point.

deficits.evidence: No street lights are visible along the length of the road in any of the frames.
deficits.suggestion: Install a series of LED street lights along both sides of the road to improve visibility and safety.

ratings.reason: The left side lacks a footway, and there is sufficient verge space to build one.
The right side lacks a footway, and there is sufficient verge space to build one.
While no crossing is visible, the road is too narrow to accommodate a central refuge island.
No street lighting is visible, and installing LED lights is a standard feasible upgrade.
